SELECT
 a1.bal_cn1 dbal_cn
,a2.bal_cn1 kbal_cn
,pr.dat ,pr.ID
,pr.NAME, pr.userinsert as UserName,pr.usercommit as COMMITTER
,a1.currencyname as val_acc, pr.val_acc as DCurrency, pr.rate_d

,pr.ammount,(select cntr_name from countries where id=nvl(:cntr_id,0)) as CNTR_NAME

,pr.lammount
,pr.op_id as Operator, sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(pr.vid_op, pr.val_acc, pr.currencyID_c) as OperationType

,pr.kredit

datasets.name: SumTrans
datasets.sql:
SELECT
 a1.bal_cn1 dbal_cn
,a2.bal_cn1 kbal_cn
,pr.dat
,pr.NAME, SB_EXPERTANALYSE.GetUserName(pr.op_id) as UserName
,sb_memorial.getcurrencyshortname(pr.val_acc) val_acc, pr.val_acc as DCurrency
,sb_memorial.getcurrencyshortname(pr.currencyid_c) currencyid_c, pr.currencyid_c as KCurrency
,pr.ammount
,pr.ammount_c
,pr.lammount
,pr.op_id as Operator, sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(pr.vid_op, pr.val_acc, pr.currencyID_c) as OperationType
,a1.acc_no debitor, a1.filial as DebetFilial
,a1.NAME dname
,a2.acc_no kreditor, a2.filial as CreditFilial
,a2.NAME kname
,pr.debt
,pr.kredit
FROM  provarch pr
     ,ACCOUNT a1
     ,ACCOUNT a2
    WHERE
       (a1.ID=pr.debt)AND(a2.ID=pr.kredit)
    AND(pr.Dat between :d1 and :d2)
/*23*/    AND(a1.bal_cn1 IN (
/*24*/ 1001 ))

/*26*/      AND(a2.bal_cn1 IN (
/*27*/ 1001 ))
    
ORDER BY :Title
   --pr.Dat--,debitor,kreditor
